name: Yamaha RD350
engine: 347 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's street two-stroke twin. Crank seals and the oil pump decide whether it lives or seizes.

add.title: Leak-down test the crankcase
add.instructions: Seal the intake and exhaust ports and pressure test the crankcase. A failed test means new crank seals, which needs the cases split.
add.reason: Leaking crank seals let a two-stroke run lean and seize.

add.title: Service the Autolube oil pump
add.instructions: Check the oil pump cable adjustment and bleed the lines so both cylinders get oil. Look for sludge or stuck parts if it won't pump.
add.reason: The engine is lubricated only by the injected oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Crank seals
known.what: Old two-stroke crank seals leak and need a full engine split.
